_about: Meal library. `items` reference foods.json ids and one of that food's measures. `estCost` is a rough rand cost per serving from typical 2026 Checkers/Woolworths prices, used until the user enters real prices. `mine: true` marks meals the user already eats; they start out kept.

meals.name: Overnight oats, blueberries & almonds
steps: Tip ½ cup oats into a jar
Pour in ¾ cup low-fat milk and stir
Add a pinch of cinnamon, lid on, fridge overnight
In the morning, top with ⅓ cup blueberries and 12 almonds
boosters: Stir in 2 tbsp oat bran: gets the bowl to about 2.4 g of beta-glucan, most of the day's 3 g
Grate in half an apple with the cinnamon
Swap almonds for toasted pumpkin seeds
A drop of vanilla in the milk

meals.name: Barley porridge with apple & cinnamon
steps: Warm ¾ cup cooked barley with ½ cup milk
Grate in half an apple
Top with walnuts and a pinch of cinnamon
boosters: Toast the walnuts in a dry pan first
A pinch of nutmeg with the cinnamon

meals.name: Poached egg on wholewheat toast
steps: Toast 2 slices of wholewheat bread
Poach 1 egg in simmering water for 3 minutes
Slice a tomato onto the toast, egg on top, black pepper
boosters: Chilli flakes and fresh coriander
Rub the toast with a cut garlic clove

meals.name: Berry & chia smoothie
steps: Add berries, banana and almond milk to the blender
Add 1 tbsp chia seeds
Blend for 30 seconds and drink within the hour
boosters: A thumb of fresh ginger
Swap the banana for frozen mango

meals.name: Warm oats with banana & walnuts
steps: Simmer ½ cup oats in 1 cup milk for 4–5 minutes, stirring
Slice half a banana on top
Scatter the walnuts and a pinch of cinnamon
boosters: Stir in 2 tbsp oat bran: gets the bowl to about 2.4 g of beta-glucan, most of the day's 3 g
Stir in 1 tsp peanut butter (100% peanuts)
A pinch of cardamom instead of cinnamon

meals.name: Peanut butter & banana on rye
steps: Toast 2 slices of rye
Spread 1 tbsp peanut butter thinly over both
Slice half a banana on top
boosters: A dusting of cinnamon
A few chia seeds for crunch

meals.name: Smashed avo & chickpeas on rye
steps: Toast 2 slices of rye
Mash a quarter avocado with ¼ cup chickpeas and a squeeze of lemon
Pile onto the toast, black pepper on top
boosters: Chilli flakes and a pinch of smoked paprika
Chopped fresh coriander or parsley

meals.name: Bircher muesli with apple & flax
steps: Mix ⅓ cup oats, ½ cup yoghurt and a splash of milk
Grate in half an apple and stir in 1 tbsp ground flax
Fridge overnight, then eat cold
boosters: Stir in 2 tbsp oat bran: gets the bowl to about 1.9 g of beta-glucan, over half of the day's 3 g
A pinch of cinnamon and a few raisins
Top with a few fresh berries

meals.name: Spinach & tomato scramble on toast
steps: Warm 1 tsp olive oil in a non-stick pan
Wilt a handful of spinach with half a chopped tomato
Add 2 beaten eggs and stir gently until just set
Serve on 1 slice of wholewheat toast
boosters: Chilli flakes and black pepper
A few chopped spring onions

meals.name: Oat bran porridge with berries & flax
steps: Simmer ¼ cup oat bran in 1 cup milk for 2–3 minutes
Stir in 1 tbsp ground flax
Top with ½ cup thawed berries
boosters: Grated orange zest
A pinch of cinnamon

meals.name: Chicken thigh salad
steps: 2 handfuls of mixed greens into the container
5–6 cherry tomatoes, halved
½ cup sliced cucumber
Cooled chicken on top
Olive oil and lemon in a separate small tub
boosters: Smoked paprika and garlic on the chicken before grilling
A few quick-pickled red onions

meals.name: Tuna & chickpea bowl
steps: 1 handful greens into the bowl
Add ½ cup rinsed chickpeas
Flake the drained tuna on top
Chopped pepper and a squeeze of lemon
boosters: Chopped parsley and a little red onion
A spoon of chakalaka on the side

meals.name: Brown rice & egg bowl
steps: 1 cup cooked brown rice into the container
Handful of greens and ½ cup cucumber
Halve a boiled egg on top
1 tsp olive oil and black pepper
boosters: Sesame seeds and sliced spring onion
A spoon of salsa or fresh chilli

meals.name: Hummus & veg wrap
steps: Spread 2 tbsp hummus over the wrap
Spinach, grated carrot and cucumber down the middle
Roll tight and cut in half
boosters: Smoked paprika stirred into the hummus
A few pickled red onions

meals.name: Black bean, corn & rice bowl
steps: ½ cup cooked brown rice into the bowl
Rinse ½ cup black beans well (cuts the tin's salt by about a third) and add
¼ cup sweetcorn and a handful of greens
2 tbsp salsa or a squeeze of lime
boosters: Cumin and lime on the beans
Chopped coriander and fresh chilli

meals.name: Kauai avo falafel wrap
steps: Order the Avo Falafel Wrap
Ask for no feta and the dressing on the side
Water with it, not a juice
boosters: Ask for extra chilli instead of extra sauce
meals._note: Kauai doesn't publish a nutrition breakdown; figures are Claude's estimate from the ingredients (chickpea falafel, avocado, nut-butter dressing, wholewheat wrap).

meals.name: Cape Malay spiced lentil soup
steps: Soften onion, carrot and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes
Add 1 tsp curry powder, ½ tsp turmeric and a cinnamon stick for 1 minute
Add the lentils and tinned tomatoes with 2 cups water, simmer 20 minutes
Blend half of it for a thicker soup; portion into containers
boosters: A squeeze of lemon just before eating
Fresh coriander and a pinch of chilli

meals.name: Chakalaka & brown rice
steps: Soften onion and pepper in the oil
Add grated carrot, 1 tsp curry powder and a little chilli
Stir in the baked beans and simmer 5 minutes
Serve on ½ cup brown rice
boosters: Extra chilli and a squeeze of lemon
A spoon of plain yoghurt on top

meals.name: Pilchards on wholewheat toast
steps: Toast 2 slices of wholewheat bread
Mash 2 pilchards with a little of their sauce
Pile onto the toast with sliced tomato and greens on the side
boosters: Chopped red onion and black pepper
A squeeze of lemon

meals.name: Chickpea curry with brown rice
steps: Soften onion and garlic in the oil
Add 1 tsp garam masala, ½ tsp cumin and ½ tsp turmeric for 1 minute
Add chickpeas and tinned tomatoes, simmer 15 minutes
Serve on ½ cup brown rice
boosters: Fresh ginger with the garlic
Coriander and a squeeze of lemon

meals.name: Barley, chickpea & feta salad
steps: ¾ cup cooked barley into the container
Add ½ cup chickpeas, cucumber and halved tomatoes
Crumble 1 tbsp feta on top
Olive oil and lemon in a separate small tub
boosters: Dried oregano and a little black pepper
A few chopped mint leaves

meals.name: Bean chilli with brown rice
steps: Soften onion and pepper in the oil
Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and chilli to taste
Add beans and tinned tomatoes, simmer 15 minutes
Serve on ½ cup brown rice
boosters: A square of dark chocolate stirred in (Mexican-style)
Lime and fresh coriander

meals.name: Mackerel & tomato wholewheat pasta
steps: Cook the pasta, drain
Toss with halved tomatoes and spinach while hot so it wilts
Flake the mackerel through
Lemon and black pepper
boosters: Chilli flakes and garlic
Capers or a few olives (small amount, they're salty)

meals.name: Lentil salad with tahini-lemon
steps: ½ cup cooked lentils into the container
Add chopped pepper, cucumber and greens
Whisk tahini with lemon and a splash of water for the dressing
Dressing in a separate small tub
boosters: Sumac or smoked paprika on top
Chopped parsley and mint

meals.name: Chicken & veg stir-fry
steps: Stir-fry sliced chicken in the oil for 4 minutes
Add garlic and the frozen veg, 3–4 minutes more
1 tsp low-sodium soy sauce at the end
Serve on ½ cup brown rice
boosters: Fresh ginger and chilli
A squeeze of lime and sesame seeds

meals.name: Apple & almonds
steps: Eat about 30–60 minutes before supper
1 apple and 10 almonds
A glass of water with it
boosters: Slice the apple and dust with cinnamon

meals.name: Carrot sticks & hummus
steps: Cut 1 carrot into sticks
2 tbsp hummus in a small tub
Eat 30–60 minutes before supper
boosters: Smoked paprika and lemon on the hummus

meals.name: Psyllium in water
steps: Stir 1 tsp psyllium husk into a big glass of water
Drink straight away, before it thickens
Follow with another glass of water
boosters: A squeeze of lemon makes it easier to drink

meals.name: Orange & walnuts
steps: Peel 1 orange
4 walnut halves
Eat 30–60 minutes before supper
boosters: Toast the walnuts in a dry pan first

meals.name: Pear & pumpkin seeds
steps: 1 pear
1 tbsp pumpkin seeds
Eat 30–60 minutes before supper
boosters: Toast the seeds with a pinch of smoked paprika

meals.name: Yoghurt with berries & chia
steps: ½ cup plain yoghurt in a tub
Top with ⅓ cup blueberries and 1 tsp chia
Eat 30–60 minutes before supper
boosters: A pinch of cinnamon

meals.name: Spiced roast chickpeas
steps: Dry rinsed chickpeas well on a towel
Toss with olive oil, smoked paprika and cumin
Roast at 200 °C for 25–30 minutes, shaking halfway
Cool and keep in a jar
boosters: Try peri-peri spice (salt-free) instead
